title: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
description: Detects execution of PowerShell with encoded command parameter, commonly used to obfuscate malicious scripts.

title: PowerShell Download Cradle
description: Detects PowerShell downloading content from the internet, a common technique for staged payload delivery.
detection_logic: Match PowerShell process with web download function calls

title: Multiple Failed Logon Attempts
description: Detects multiple authentication failures from a single source, indicating possible brute-force activity.
detection_logic: Count Event ID 4625 > 5 within 5 minutes from same source

title: New Local User Account Created
description: Detects creation of a new local user account, which may indicate attacker persistence via backdoor account.

title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation
description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks via schtasks.exe or similar, which may indicate persistence or lateral movement.

title: LSASS Memory Access
description: Detects access to the LSASS process memory, which may indicate credential dumping activity.
detection_logic: Match process access events targeting lsass.exe (Sysmon Event ID 10)

title: Network Discovery Commands
description: Detects execution of common network discovery commands that may indicate an attacker mapping the network.
detection_logic: Match execution of common network reconnaissance utilities

title: Remote Desktop Protocol Logon
description: Detects RDP logon events which may indicate lateral movement or unauthorized remote access.
detection_logic: Match Event ID 4624 with Logon Type 10 (RemoteInteractive)

title: Suspicious Outbound Connection
description: Detects outbound network connections to known suspicious IP ranges or on non-standard ports.
detection_logic: Match network connections to known bad IPs or unusual destination ports

title: Command Shell Execution
description: Detects suspicious command shell (cmd.exe) executions, particularly from uncommon parent processes.
detection_logic: Match cmd.exe spawned from unusual parent processes like Office or browsers

title: Account Discovery via Net Commands
description: Detects use of 'net user' or 'net group' commands for account enumeration.
detection_logic: Match net.exe with user or group enumeration arguments

title: Suspicious File Download via certutil
description: Detects use of certutil.exe for file download, a common living-off-the-land technique.
